title: Clean full requirement
shows: All seven fields pulled from one natural conversation
point_out: Every field on the right came from free-flowing speech - nothing was a form.
expect: city=Pune, area=Baner, property_type=Apartment, bhk=2, budget=60 lakhs -> 6000000, furnishing=Fully Furnished, amenities include Swimming Pool + Gym
turns: Hi, thanks for calling EstateIQ! What kind of property are you looking for?
Hi, we're looking to buy a 2 BHK apartment in Baner, Pune.
Great. Do you have a budget in mind?
Any preferences on furnishing or amenities?
Fully furnished would be ideal, and we'd really like a swimming pool and a gym in the society.

title: Code-mixed Hindi / English call
shows: Multilingual extraction - MuRIL handles Hinglish that English-only rules miss
point_out: The sentence mixes Hindi and English mid-phrase. A plain English model would lose the requirement here.
expect: area=Wakad, city=Pune (inferred from area), bhk=3, budget=80 lakh -> 8000000, amenities include Gym + Parking
turns: Namaste! Aap kis type ki property dhoondh rahe hain?
Mujhe Wakad mein 3 BHK flat chahiye.
Budget kitna soch rahe hain aap?
Budget around 80 lakh hai, aur gym aur parking zaroor chahiye.

title: Negation - what the caller ruled OUT
shows: The system separates the rejection from the requirement
point_out: The caller says 'villa' out loud - but as a rejection. A naive keyword match would record Villa. We record the apartment, and log the villa as rejected.
expect: property_type=Apartment (NOT Villa), negated lists villa, city=Pune, area=Kothrud, budget=75 lakhs -> 7500000
turns: What sort of property are you after?
Not a villa, we want an apartment in Kothrud, Pune.
About 75 lakhs, semi furnished is fine.

title: Multi-city - caller's location vs. target city
shows: Two cities in one call; the system picks the one being shopped in
point_out: Mumbai and Nashik are both mentioned. Mumbai is where they live; Nashik is where they're buying. The system picks Nashik.
expect: city=Nashik (NOT Mumbai), area=Gangapur Road, bhk=3, budget=one crore twenty lakhs -> 12000000
turns: Hello! How can I help with your property search?
I'm currently based in Mumbai, but we want to buy in Nashik.
Gangapur Road, a 3 BHK. Budget is around one crore twenty lakhs.
